title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Two silent commands in the browser
summary: Find usages and Go to test returned without a word in the browser build, where the desktop explains what to open first.

highlights.title: A walkthrough link that looked broken
highlights.description: Find usages clicked from the walkthrough page, with nothing focused, says what to do on the desktop and said nothing at all in the browser.

highlights.title: Checked command by command
highlights.description: The two builds share 65 commands. A test now requires that a shared command never speaks on one side and stays silent on the other.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Find usages tells you what to open in the browser too, instead of returning silently.
Go to test does the same.
